title: a waiting-page option that asks for a press in a web app links to it
why: Gripe, Oct 28 13:01 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 47 note): "in these scenarios, option A should've provided me the link out of convenience to github". Item 47's option a asked him to mark home#374 ready and press Merge, with no link to the PR.
note: Next cloud lane: in skills/waiting-page, an option may carry links (label and url) shown on its card; the writer refuses an option or step that names a press in a web app (GitHub PR, settings page) without a link to that exact page; SKILL.md says so. Red first on item 47's old shape. Also (orchestrator, Oct 28 13:23 CDT): a task whose step is a command carries the command block in the item itself, never "open file X and run its command"; shiv should never hunt for the thing he must act on. Red first on item 39's old shape (steps: open plans/c152-stale-branch-deletes.md, run its command). Needs no answer. Port: yes, the skill installs everywhere. Due after: c188 merges (same skill files). Placed after c188 (triage 11, Oct 28): a gripe on every act-in-a-web-app item.
